title: Intensional semantics for comparison problems in arithmetic geometry
summary: This work proposes a semantic environment for arithmetic geometry in which passage between presentations carries an explicit weight. Morphism costs induce a Lawvere generalized distance by taking infima over transports, and heights satisfy the corresponding transport bounds. A labeled quantitative $(2,1)$-category retains invertible $2$-morphisms as coherent comparisons between transports. Its vertical groupoids admit a transport interpretation inspired by the identity types of Voevodsky's C-systems.
